name: Hollywood Story
source: Fate presents you with a HOT opportunity of becoming a Hollywood actress. William, a powerful man, runs the most successful production company. Azel, a breathtakingly gorgeous actor, thinks that you are talented...
translation: 命运为你送来了成为好莱坞女演员的火热机会。权势显赫的威廉，经营着最成功的制作公司。而俊美得令人屏息的演员阿泽尔，也认定你天赋出众……
